content.title: Open a security preview by explicit ticker activation
content.intent: Prove explicit ticker activation opens the preview popover with security details without reflowing the page.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: equivalence partitioning over preview-entry modes, with explicit activation treated as a distinct interaction class from hover. strength=2 by risk judgement because no money, auth, or data-loss factors apply; no covering-array sweep was needed because the path has one varying input class.
